newsitem.title: USA: Westell shares drop on earnings warning.
newsitem.headline: Westell shares drop on earnings warning.

text.p: Shares of Westell Technologies Inc fell more than 16 percent on Friday after the company said it would likely report a loss in its fiscal third quarter.
Cowen & Co said it downgraded its rating on the stock to neutral from buy following the announcement.
Shares of Westell traded 4-5/8 lower at 23-3/8.

Westell said it expected a loss for the third quarter ending December 31 of $0.10 to $0.12, as it is expecting the release of its next generation of digital subscriber line technology to be delayed until January.
According to First Call, the consensus of analysts' estimates was a profit of $0.05 a share.
Kevin Slocum, an analyst with Soundview Financial Group, said he disagrees with the Cowen move, and is not overly concerned about the delay.

"I'm telling clients that I think this is the last spate of bad news we'll have to look at for a while, and there are a lot of good things to come," Slocum said, adding that the stock has a volatile history.
"This is obviously a risky name, it's not for your average Joe," Slocum said.
